save_checkpoint: save a fairseq training checkpoint to disk with optimizer state and validation loss
load_checkpoint: load a fairseq checkpoint and restore the training iterator from a saved file
load_model_ensemble: load an ensemble of fairseq models from checkpoint files for inference
load_pretrained_component_from_model: load a pretrained encoder or decoder component from a fairseq checkpoint file
prune_state_dict: prune a model state dict for LayerDrop to keep specified encoder or decoder layers
